title: LINES SAID WITH THE MAP OPEN DRAW OVER IT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, and a callout is never hidden by the map. The message band was drawn before the sector map, whose dark backing covers the screen, so with the map open a Waypoint marked line, a ring closing or a Crier marking you was drawn underneath it and never seen. With the map open the band is now drawn after the map, over it. With the map shut nothing changes.
now: Messages and alerts said while the sector map is open now show over the map instead of under it.
